title: 2020 年 7 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

analysis.reference: The Romance of the Three Kingdoms is a famous Chinese historical novel written in the 14th century. Set against the historical backdrop of the Three Kingdoms period, this literary work depicts the wars among the three kingdoms of Wei, Shu, and Wu from the second half of the 2nd century AD to the second half of the 3rd century AD. The novel portrays nearly a thousand characters and countless historical events. Although these characters and events are mostly based on real history, they have all been romanticized and dramatized to varying degrees. The Romance of the Three Kingdoms is a universally acknowledged literary masterpiece. Since its publication, the novel has been continuously attracting generations of readers and has exerted a broad and lasting influence on Chinese culture.

pitfalls: 「以……为背景」易直译为 use...as background，应用 set against the backdrop of
「公元二世纪下半叶」中 second half 与序数词 2nd 易混淆拼写或遗漏 AD
「不同程度地」易误译为 in different degrees，地道表达为 to varying degrees
「浪漫化/戏剧化」词形变化易出错，需注意 romanticized / dramatized 的拼写
「自面世以来」时态必须用现在完成时或现在完成进行时，用一般过去时会失分

upgrades.plain: is based on the history of the Three Kingdoms period
upgrades.better: set against the historical backdrop of the Three Kingdoms period
upgrades.note: 过去分词短语作状语更简洁地道，backdrop 比 background 更具文学色彩

upgrades.plain: has attracted readers of many generations
upgrades.better: has been continuously attracting generations of readers
upgrades.note: 现在完成进行时更突出「不断吸引」的持续性与动态感

upgrades.plain: had a wide and long influence on
upgrades.better: exerted a broad and lasting influence on
upgrades.note: exert influence 为高级搭配；broad and lasting 比 wide and long 更精准

upgrades.plain: is a masterpiece that everyone recognizes
upgrades.better: is a universally acknowledged literary masterpiece
upgrades.note: universally acknowledged 更正式凝练，避免定语从句的冗余

upgrades.plain: were made more romantic and dramatic
upgrades.better: have been romanticized and dramatized to varying degrees
upgrades.note: 使用专业动词的被动态更学术，to varying degrees 体现程度差异更精确
